stages.name: preflight
stages.pass: Verified disposable Sandbox, selected default/Evaluation/authorized guest-Off profile, artifact and cache integrity
stages.method: guest diagnostics and bounded guest-only SAC preparation

stages.name: installer
stages.pass: Security: unchanged enforcement rejects unsigned EXE with correlated Code Integrity event. Functional: fresh install and binary presence; full lifecycle when explicitly requested

stages.name: desktop
stages.pass: UI mode: actual installed desktop wizard renders; Api mode: installed backend identity and setup diagnostics respond
stages.method: explicit UI WebView2 CDP or installed backend HTTP API; recorded per run

stages.name: whisper
inputs: pinned official Whisper revision and hashes or explicit network download
stages.pass: Fresh CPU readiness and actual MP4 transcription with nonempty bounded segments; UI mode also performs the short WAV probe unless an exact proof applies
stages.method: explicit UI controls or installed application API; real worker in both modes

stages.name: ollama-install
inputs: pinned signed official installer cache object
stages.pass: Verified official installer, local service version and application component status
stages.method: guest preparation CLI and explicit UI/API component checks

stages.name: ollama-model
inputs: verified model cache or explicit network pull
stages.pass: Model physically present with digest and connected through the selected UI/API adapter
stages.method: guest preparation CLI and explicit UI/API model selection

stages.name: ollama-inference
stages.pass: Real completed nonempty generation; records device-independent timing and raw response
stages.method: diagnostic HTTP API; does not claim UI generation

stages.name: translation
stages.pass: Selected UI/API action completes a separate job; saved Russian translation covers every segment and SRT contains timestamps
stages.method: explicit UI or API acceptance, never relabelled as the other

stages.name: notes
stages.pass: Selected UI/API notes action completes; saved notes, chapters, translation and report persist
stages.method: explicit UI or API acceptance, never relabelled as the other

stages.name: cleanup
stages.pass: Application processes confined to this guest installation disposed; reports preserved
